note: Whether a SessionStart command hook that prints hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext reaches the session's context, what an empty print does, and the size, timing and trust limits on that path. Field names, type names, counts, timings and verdicts only; no prompt, reply, probe word, id or path is recorded.

registration: a hooks.json in an isolated CODEX_HOME with one SessionStart command hook, matcher empty
invocation: codex exec --skip-git-repo-check -s read-only --json, stdin closed, model_reasoning_effort low on the default model, --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust except in the trust arms
recorder: a probe script that saved its stdin to the scratch folder and printed the ruled JSON with a random probe word in additionalContext, or nothing
zero_cost_method: an unrecognised -m model name: the SessionStart hook runs and the rollout records what it injected, then the turn fails before any model request
credential: auth.json SYMLINKED from the real CODEX_HOME, never read or copied; the isolated home was deleted afterwards

schema_in_binary: session-start.command.input: all seven keys required, transcript_path nullable, source one of startup, resume, clear, compact, fork

session-start.command.output: top level continue, hookSpecificOutput, stopReason, suppressOutput, systemMessage; hookSpecificOutput admits only hookEventName (required, const SessionStart) and additionalContext (string), additionalProperties false
verdict: ACCEPTED: the rollout records the text as hook context.

what: ruled JSON, one probe word, prompt asking the model to repeat any probe word in its context
verdict: IN THE REQUEST, NOT RECITED: twice the model said NONE although the rollout holds the text as a developer message ahead of the prompt.

what: ruled JSON telling the model to end every reply with a probe word, prompt asking for OK
verdict: REACHED: the model followed the injected text. It acts on hook context but declined to quote it when asked.
ADDS NOTHING: no hooks.additional_context message is written; the rollout goes from the environment context straight to the person's text.

unit: bytes: 5,001 two-byte characters were truncated; the header counts tokens as bytes divided by four (2,501 for 10,001 bytes)
truncated_form: a 'Warning: truncated output (original token count: N)' line and a 'Total output lines: N' line, then the head and the tail of the text with the middle replaced by an inline '…N tokens truncated…' marker, then a line naming a file under the system temp folder that holds the whole output
verdict: additionalContext up to 10,000 bytes is injected whole; over that it is cut in the middle, so the head and the tail both reach the model.

what: ruled JSON after an 8 s sleep, no timeout set
verdict: WAITED FOR: the turn's prompt is not sent until the hook finishes, and its text still arrives.

what: ruled JSON after a 5 s sleep, hook timeout set to 2
verdict: KILLED AT THE TIMEOUT, SILENTLY: nothing is injected, the session carries on, and nothing in exec output says the hook timed out.

order: after the environment context and before the person's text in the same turn
verdict: The injected text is stored in the rollout once, as a developer-role message the harness marks as hook context.

arms.trusted: the same hook with a changed command line

prompt_form: 'Hooks need review', with Review hooks, Trust all and continue, and Continue without trusting (hooks won't run)
persisted_as: a [hooks.state."<hooks.json path>:session_start:0:0"] table with a sha256 trusted_hash in CODEX_HOME/config.toml
verdict: Trust is granted once per CODEX_HOME and per hook definition: exec skips an untrusted hook without a word, and changing the hook's command makes it untrusted again.

items: the default hook timeout when none is set (only that 8 s was waited for in full)
a hook registered by an installed plugin, whose trust path may differ from a CODEX_HOME hooks.json
interactive turns and source values other than startup
